name: Goi la lim kim
summary: Gỏi lá lìm kìm is a salad of a small watery mangrove vine, with cá bống sao fried crisp or with dried fish. It is salty and sour, with a sweet finish that changes with the rain and the hour.
origin: Can Gio. VnExpress, 22 Sep 2021. Eco parks serve it.
howToEat: Pick the leaves at dawn, when they are least astringent. Stem them, wash, drain, and leave them whole. Add herbs, thin onion, and peeled roasted peanuts. Dress lightly so the leaves stay crisp.

The sauce is sweet-sour nước mắm with garlic and chili, given at a 1:1 ratio. From April through October, the rainy months, the leaf is thin and barely salty. In the dry months it is thicker and saltier, and the sauce is adjusted.
Fry cá bống sao crisp outside and still soft inside, take the flesh, and pour sweet-sour fish sauce over it.
where: Eco parks in Cần Giờ. VnExpress names no gate and no street.
seoTitle: Goi la lim kim — mangrove leaf salad in Can Gio
seoDescription: Gỏi lá lìm kìm is a mangrove-leaf salad with fried cá bống sao or dried fish, salty and sour with a sweet finish.
texture: The leaf is crisp and watery. Fried cá bống sao is crisp outside and still soft inside.
taste: Salty, sour, and a sweet finish, changing with the season. Basil, rau răm, and peanuts. The sauce is sweet, sour, salty, and hot.
